subject: pol-dym
title: POL.DYM.------ALT.F.
description: Diagram in WAM-27, paired with v1-p85-1 on the same page. (C)POL-DYM (political dynamics) is crossed with ALT-F (alternative functionalism): if the previous diagram established that western methodology is politically constituted, this one stages the inverse — what alternative functionalism would have to confront to rework the political-dynamic regime. POL-DYM is fed by TRS (transition), POL-P (political policies), and PHY-U-P (physical universe particular), and outputs to ALT-F and MTH (methodology). A separate chain runs (r)PART (the reality of participation) → INFO-OR (information order) → fanning into LANG-DY (language dynamics), AFTF (affinity transfer), EXT-FT (extended functionalism), and MT-INFO (music information). The structural claim: alternative functionalism's relation to political dynamics is *not* mediated by participation in the diagram — the participation chain runs entirely through information order into the western-aligned outputs (language, affinity transfer, extended functionalism, music information). Read against the page's prose, this argues that genuine alternative functionalism would require bypassing the participation→information-order chain that western culture has institutionalized — i.e., it would require dismantling the very route by which 'what is interesting' has replaced 'what is unifying'.
